release_blockers.ADC_SUPPLY_SEQUENCE: ADC VDRIVE can exceed AVCC + 0.3 V with USB-only power or unequal rail decay; supply and host-signal isolation need a hardware revision.

release_blockers.CONVERTER_BACKEND: The new ADC/DAC backend is absent; stock libDaisy clocks and shared SPI DMA cannot sustain the declared rates.
